Shubham Dubey

 +917999833936, 101shubhamdubey@gmail.com https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubham-dubey-815124159/

With 6 years in AI/ML, including 2+ years leading a team of 8+, I specialize in developing and deploying machine learning models, generative AI, and cloud-based solutions. I excel in managing teams, leading complex projects, and driving business growth through strategic AI initiatives.

Additionally, I have led initiatives across Healthcare, Banking, Retail, Finance and Advanced Manufacturing.

Skills

GenAI: Falcon 7B & 40B, llama-2, gpt-3.5-turbo & gpt-3.5-turbo-16k, gpt-4, gpt-4o-mini, Stable Diffusion XL LoRa, Llama Index, LangChain, LangSmith, LangGraph, LangFlow.

Azure & AWS, GCP - VertexAI, MLOps, SageMaker Studio

Data Science, Data Engineering, GitHub, Git, IoT, SQL, API, Python, Linux, Docker

Machine Learning & Deep Learning Algorithms

Packages - Scikit-Learn, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, NLTK, Tensorflow, Keras, OpenCV, Jupyter, Streamlit, boto3.

Experience

Ernst & Young, Senior Data Scientist - Data & AI (2022 - Current)

GenAI-Powered Financial Insights Chatbot

Designed and developed a web-based chatbot for querying and analyzing financial data from multiple sources using Generative AI.

Implemented intent-based query routing to direct user inputs to the appropriate function, including Text-to-SQL generation (developed as an MCP), contract analysis, and financial report generation — all within a unified chatbot interface.

Integrated A2A protocol to enable secure, automated application-to-application data exchange between internal financial systems and the chatbot backend.

Used a Knowledge Graph to store the database schema and improve the accuracy of SQL generation by providing the LLM with structured schema context.

Developed backend APIs using FastAPI and created a user-friendly interface with React.

Containerized the application using Docker and deployed it as a single Azure Web App.

Implemented centralized logging using Python’s logging module and integrated it with Azure Monitor for real-time tracking, diagnostics, and alerting across deployed components.

GenAI-Powered Customer Support Chatbot for CSR Teams

Built a Generative AI chatbot to assist Customer Support Representatives (CSR) by reducing manual workload and improving response accuracy.

Integrated an agent-based framework to intelligently choose between invoking an LLM or executing predefined triage logic based on user intent.

Enabled page-level citations in Azure Cognitive Service using fuzzy logic to improve content traceability and ensure that generated responses reference the most relevant document sections.

Leveraged Redis for caching frequent queries, significantly reducing response time and minimizing unnecessary LLM invocations.

Integrated a React-based frontend with a FastAPI backend to enable seamless and efficient communication.

2

CloudThat, Sr. Research Associate - Cloud AI (2021 - 2022)

End-to-End Predictive Analytics and MLOps Pipeline on AWS

Phase 1 – Predictive Analysis on Logistic Data:

Analyzed logistic datasets comprising 25–40 lakh records from four detailed reports using Databricks for EDA and SageMaker for model development.

Created interactive dashboards in QuickSight, enabled cross-account deployment using QuickSight Boto3 APIs, and implemented anomaly detection and a SageMaker Inference Pipeline for real-time insights.

Phase 2 – MLOps Pipeline Setup:

Built a fully automated MLOps pipeline using AWS SageMaker, Lambda, and CodePipeline to manage the complete ML lifecycle.

Integrated API Gateway with Lambda to invoke model endpoints, used EventBridge and CloudWatch Alarms for alerting, and employed CodeBuild with pytest for test coverage reporting.

Automated Feature Store operations via SageMaker Boto3 API.

Digivalet, Project Engineer (2019 - 2021)

Hand gesture recognition using Mediapipe.

Leveraged MediaPipe’s Hand Tracking API to capture real-time finger coordinates and calculate inter-finger angles, enabling gesture-based action triggering.

Deployed the application using AWS ECS with Fargate, ensuring scalable and serverless container orchestration.

Employed Git and Github for efficient version control, team collaboration, and continuous code integration throughout development.

Education

MITM , Indore - ECE , August 2015 - May 2019

Electronics & Communication Engineering from Medicaps Institute of Technology and Management.

MHSS, Seoni — 12th, Higher Secondary Certificate from Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education in the year 2015.

MHSS, Seoni — 1oth, Secondary School Certificate from Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education in the year 2013.

Blog Published

AWS Industry 4.0,Technologies to Help in Productivity.

Leverage The Advantages Of AI/ML Through AWS.

Amazon Rekognition For Custom Computer Vision.

Implementing Dropout Regularization for Neural Networks in Deep Learning.

Collaboration of Hugging Face & AWS SageMaker Brings Revolution to NLP Model Training

Shubham Dubey

Pune, Aug 11, 2025
